hints.content: A dilation by a scale factor of $4$ will map $A'$ to a point $4$ times as far from $P$ as point $A$ was, but in the same direction.

Point $A$ is $\maroonD{2}$ units down from point $P$.

The image $A'$ will be $4(\purpleC{0})=0$ units right and $4(\maroonD{2})=8$ units down from point $P$.
